title: access_role
description: A named bundle of capabilities that can be given to a person, such as Super admin or Region head (see ACCESS_GUIDE.md and ACCESS_ROLE_GUIDE.md). The capability list in this schema is the one table of what the Console and the server can allow; a role is a choice from it. Rules the schema cannot express: key is unique among live records and never changes; a role with is_super_admin true holds every capability, listed or not; a role that is not a super admin needs at least one capability; a role that people still hold cannot be deleted; the last active super admin role cannot be switched off; fields marked readOnly are set by the server only.
x_retention: Kept until the owner deletes it. (A written policy only; nothing enforces it yet.)

key.description: A short snake_case name for the role, such as super_admin or region_head. Unique among live records. Set once; the label is what people read. Required.

label.description: The plain-words name shown in the Console, such as Region head. Up to 120 characters. Required.

description.description: One or two sentences on who this role is for and what it is meant to do. Up to 1,000 characters. Optional.

capabilities.description: The things a person with this role may do, chosen from the fixed list (each is explained in ACCESS_ROLE_GUIDE.md). No repeats. Omitted when the role is a super admin, which holds all of them.

is_super_admin.description: true when the role may do everything, now and for any capability added later, and may manage access. Required.

is_active.description: The on/off switch. false means people holding the role are refused at their next request. Required.

id.description: UUID v4, set by the server; also the Firestore document id.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written under (currently 1). Set by the server.

created_at.description: When the record was created (UTC). Set by the server.

created_by.description: Who created it, as an actor string. Set by the server.

updated_at.description: When the record last changed (UTC). Set by the server.

updated_by.description: Who last changed it. Set by the server.

source.description: Where the record came from: dashboard or import. Set by the server.

deleted_at.description: When the record was soft deleted (UTC); absent while live. Set by the server.

deleted_by.description: Who soft deleted it. Set by the server.
